Read the issue context and available attachments in the input records. Inspect the
current code and produce a concrete implementation plan. Do not edit application code
or delegate this planning stage.

The markdown must include Summary, Scope, Phases, Implementation Steps, Dependency
Edges, Estimated Files, Tests, and Questions & Clarifications. Explain decisions and
package boundaries precisely enough to produce independent implementation tickets.
List material unresolved requirements in questions. The workflow posts the plan for
human approval before implementation begins.
